claims.statement: APM reports DI strongest aggregate academic ranking

severe_test.would_narrow: The original 1977 model/domain weighting does not exhibit the APM-reported aggregate DI lead
severe_test.would_strengthen: An independently sourced matched-original specification reproduces the reported aggregate ranking

claims.statement: DI advantage stable over matched disputed adjustments
claims.scope: same 1977 outcome domain, population and models

severe_test.would_narrow: A matched original House/St Pierre specification reverses DI's rank or makes it statistically indistinguishable under defined interval
severe_test.would_strengthen: Original comparable model-domain estimates preserve DI's advantage across the explicitly enumerated adjustment set

claims.scope: potential mediation of specific measured affective outcome

severe_test.would_narrow: Measured confidence precedes competence gains or common factors explain both
severe_test.would_strengthen: Prospective temporally ordered measured mediation survives confounder and measurement sensitivity

claims.statement: DI skills persist under later instructional changes
claims.scope: five-site grade 5-6 continuation, no universal claim

severe_test.would_narrow: Follow-up attrition or comparator reconstruction explains the apparent retained skills
severe_test.would_strengthen: Within-cohort exposed-versus-comparator outcomes remain favourable after attrition and later-school corrections

claims.statement: specific evidence withheld or not disseminated by decision

severe_test.would_narrow: A dated original decision releases/reports the allegedly withheld item and directly contradicts its precise suppression claim
severe_test.would_strengthen: A contemporaneous original memo establishes the specified deliberate withholding and decision authority

claims.statement: government response caused nationwide later educational decline

severe_test.would_narrow: No identifiable policy counterfactual links dissemination to aggregate nationwide trajectory
severe_test.would_strengthen: Credible policy exposure, downstream outcome and rival-policy identification establish attributable national effect

actions.description: Acquire IV-A/B original model-site outcome tables with pages
Recover explicit reanalysis input and transformations
Track dated federal allocations and internal reports
Acquire five-site cohort and attrition record
